name: MarkItDown
description: Convert supported documents or HTML into Markdown.
whenToUse: Convert a document or HTML file into Markdown before summarizing or extracting content.
Reduce PDF/document context cost by converting first, then reading the resulting Markdown.
failureModes: The local markitdown command is not installed or not on PATH.
The input file type is unsupported or malformed.
Large documents may need caller-side chunking after conversion.
